dedupe_keys.name: gas and hydrogen network municipal heat planning hamburg settlement areas supplied with gas and likely hydrogen core network supply

description: This data set of the Hamburg environment, climate, energy and agriculture authority (BUKEA), prepared for municipal heat planning under the German Heat Planning Act of 20 December 2023, states for every settlement area of the Free and Hanseatic City of Hamburg whether at least one building in the area is supplied with natural gas by pipe or not. It also shows whether an area is very likely to be able to receive hydrogen in future through the planned hydrogen core network. The Transparency Portal entry, first published on 10 October 2025 with a newer version dated 13 October 2025, offers WFS downloads in GML (about 57 MB) with an XSD schema, GeoJSON, CSV and OGC API Features access, WMS and WFS services, and metadata from MetaVer. Coverage is the city of Hamburg by settlement area. Data are free under the Data Licence Germany Zero 2.0. Caveats: the data give a yes or no per area, not pipe routes, pressures or capacities, and hydrogen supply is an assessment of likelihood tied to network plans. Simulation uses are heat planning and gas phase-out or hydrogen conversion scenarios at district level. Related records: data-nrw-municipal-heat-planning-data-lanuk gives heat planning data for North Rhine-Westphalia, and data-berlin-energy-networks-district-heating-gas-proximity covers Berlin.
